headline: Davivienda secures $125 million green financing facility from Proparco
summary: Colombia's Banco Davivienda and French development finance institution Proparco agreed on a $125 million, five-year credit line targeted at green buildings and renewable energy investments across Colombia.
why: Davivienda is one of Colombia's largest private commercial lenders, and multilateral green facilities provide subsidized long-term funding for sustainable urban development.

impacts.name: Banco Davivienda
impacts.why: Securing $125 million in international funding expands its green lending portfolio.
